home.intro: The Cui Mingjian Lab at the School of Electrical and Information Engineering, Tianjin University, focuses on renewable energy forecasting, power system optimal operation, and power system cyber security, with long-standing work on machine learning and deep learning for power systems.

highlights.title: Research Directions
highlights.desc: Four pillars: renewable energy forecasting, power system optimal operation, power system cyber security, and AI — tackling core scientific and engineering problems under high renewable penetration.

highlights.title: Recent Outputs
highlights.desc: Continuous papers in IEEE Transactions on Power Systems / Smart Grid / Sustainable Energy (Q1), with the PI listed among the World's Top 2% Scientists in 2023 and 2024.

highlights.title: Recruitment & Collaboration
highlights.desc: Actively recruiting master's and PhD students (3–4 per year) and undergraduate research interns; open to industry collaboration and joint training.

research.title: Renewable Energy Forecasting
research.desc: High-precision probabilistic forecasting and uncertainty quantification for wind and solar, enabling safe integration of high renewable share.

research.title: Power System Optimal Operation
research.desc: Robust economic dispatch, security-constrained optimization, and distributed coordination under uncertainty.

research.title: Power System Cyber Security
research.desc: Attack detection, situational awareness, and resilient defense in cyber-physical power systems.

research.title: AI for Power Systems
research.desc: Theory and applications of machine learning and deep learning in power system sensing, decision, and modeling.

platform.title: Affiliation
platform.school: Tianjin University School of Electrical and Information Engineering
platform.desc: The lab is based in the School of Electrical and Information Engineering, Tianjin University, working on renewable forecasting, power system operation, and cyber security, with interdisciplinary and international collaboration in frontiers such as energy storage.
